svg.title: Launch Manager - Run Target Transition Failure

g.text: Launch Manager - Run Target Transition Failure
Components StateManager and setup_filesystems.sh are Ready.
See Run Target Activation sequence diagrams for details.
[up to the configured activation attempts for app1]
[app1 does not report Running within the configured ready timeout]
SIGTERM (escalation to SIGKILL after shutdown timeout)
All configured activation attempts for app1 exhausted,
Remove any queued requests (here: none are queued)
Determine Run Target Recovery Action configured for Run Target "Running"
The only supported Run Target Recovery Action is the activation
of the Fallback Run Target, here Run Target "Fallback".
Determine transition plan from current state -> "Fallback"
Run Target "Fallback" only depends on Component StateManager, which is already Ready.
app1 was never activated and therefore stays deactivated.
random is not part of Run Target "Fallback" and is therefore terminated.
The underlying process for app1 is already in state terminated. No further action required.
[random terminates within the configured shutdown timeout]
[random does not terminate within the configured timeout]
due to Run Target Recovery Action
